text:
jane_acme: Hey team — trying to export audit logs for my org (org_42). Export button in the UI is disabled and the API returns 403 with "entitlement_missing". I'm an SSO user (Okta) and my role should be org-auditor. Can someone help?

support-bot: Thanks for the report! A ticket (SUP-10234) has been created and assigned to @matt_r. Please include any request IDs or curl you used.

matt_r: Hi @jane_acme — quick Qs to reproduce: are you using the UI export or calling the API? If API, can you paste the curl (redact tokens) and the raw 403 body? Also what's the user_id and the timestamp when it failed?

jane_acme: UI first (browser) — button greyed out. Tried the API too, here's the curl I ran:```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"range":"2026-03-01_to_2026-03-14","format":"ndjson"}'```Response: ```{ "error": "entitlement_missing", "message": "missing: audit_logs.export", "code": 403 }```user_id: user_987, org_id: org_42. Happened ~2026-03-14T15:12:05Z.

sana_support: thanks — that error message is helpful. Two common causes for SSO users: 1) SAML/SCIM role mapping didn't include the export entitlement, or 2) the org-level retention/entitlement flag for exports is off for your plan.

olivia_sec: to add — check whether your IdP is sending an attribute that maps to our internal entitlement claim. In Okta it often looks like a SAML attribute named `entitlements` or SCIM group -> app role mapping. If SCIM provisioning creates the user without the role, the user will lack `audit_logs.export` even if they appear as org-auditor in the IdP UI.

matt_r: @olivia_sec good call. @jane_acme I pulled your user record from our admin panel: current entitlements = `["audit_logs.read"]` — export entitlement missing. That matches the 403. Two ways to fix: 1) Org admin can grant `audit_logs.export` in Org settings -> Compliance -> Entitlements, or 2) fix SCIM mapping so new/updated SSO users receive the `audit_logs.export` entitlement automatically. Which do you prefer?

jane_acme: Our org wants SCIM to be canonical. Can you share the minimal repro steps so our IdP team can verify mapping?

sana_support: repro steps we shared with customers: 1) In IdP, add a SAML attribute `entitlements` (or an OIDC claim `roles`) containing `audit_logs.export`. 2) Trigger a SCIM update to push attributes. 3) Wait ~30s for provisioning, then call internal check: ```GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/org_42/users/user_987/entitlements```should return `["audit_logs.read","audit_logs.export"]`. If export missing, you get the 403 above.

matt_r: if you want to test quickly without IdP changes, an org admin can temporarily grant the entitlement via the UI: Org settings -> Compliance -> Entitlements -> Add `audit_logs.export` -> Save. After that the export button and API should work immediately.

support-bot: Admin action logged: grant_entitlement by org_admin_12 -> user_987: audit_logs.export (SUP-10234) :eyes:

jane_acme: I asked our IdP team to push SCIM updates and meanwhile our org admin (Lena) granted the entitlement via the UI as a stopgap. Confirmed the export UI is now enabled and the API export succeeded: ```{ "export_id": "exp_20260314_001", "status": "queued" }``` :party_parrot:

olivia_sec: follow-up note for your IdP team: make sure SCIM mapping for the app includes `entitlements` in the `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User` extension or as custom attribute mapping. If using SAML, map to the SAML attribute exactly as configured in the SCIM/SSO app settings.

sana_support: marking this resolved in the ticket but leaving guidance for a permanent fix. If you want, we can schedule a short call with our IdP integration specialist to validate mappings.

matt_r: internal action items: (1) update KB article "SSO -> audit export entitlement mapping" with the SCIM/SAML examples; (2) add an automated admin console check that surfaces users with `audit_logs.read` but missing `audit_logs.export`.

jane_acme: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help and the workaround. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket SUP-10234 closed by matt_r (resolution: entitlement granted by org admin; IdP mapping guidance provided).
